report.title: مصر و«كاتل» الصينية تطلقان مصنع بطاريات باستثمار 39 مليون دولار

confirmed.sentence: مصر و«كاتل» الصينية تطلقان مصنع بطاريات باستثمار 39 مليون دولار
confirmed.quote: A more than 2 billion Egyptian pound ($39 million) investment will be used to establish an electric-battery manufacturing plant in Egypt by local battery maker BME and China’s Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd., as the country seeks to develop its electric-vehicle industry and expand local manufacturing.
confirmed.correction: CATL's partner in the plant is the Egyptian battery maker BME, not the Egyptian state, and the investment is more than $39 million.

confirmed.sentence: حضر رئيس الوزراء مصطفى مدبولي توقيع عقد إنشاء المصنع، إلى جانب وزير الصناعة خالد هاشم ورئيس BME ماجد وهاب ومدير CATL للاستثمار الدولي لوهينغ.
confirmed.quote: The agreement was signed by Maged Wahib, chairman of BME, and Luo Haining, CATL’s director of international investment. Egypt’s Industry Minister Khaled Hashem attended the signing, along with BME project manager Amin Karim Ghabbour and board member Lotfy Tadros.
confirmed.correction: The agreement was signed by BME chairman Maged Wahib and CATL's director of international investment Luo Haining; the story misrenders both names.

confirmed.sentence: وتسعى مصر لرفع حصة الطاقات المتجددة إلى 45% من توليد الكهرباء بحلول 2028، مع إضافة بطاريات تخزين بقدرة نحو 1.1 جيجاوات لتعزيز سعة الشبكة الكهربائية.
confirmed.quote: The government aims to raise renewable sources to 45 percent of electricity generation by 2028, while battery-storage additions are planned to increase grid capacity using the technology to about 1.1 GW.
confirmed.correction: About 1.1 GW is the planned total grid battery-storage capacity after the additions, not the size of the additions themselves.
